title: anchorgate: an evaluation protocol with a gate for spatiotemporal predictions

description: anchorgate scores saved predictions of a spatiotemporal field against untrained references (per-cell climatology, persistence, seasonal naive) on identical targets, audits whether a cross-validation assignment is out of sample given the forecast horizon, resolves seed variance before any architectural claim, reads its verdicts from block-bootstrap intervals and refuses conclusions the computations do not support. A declaration fixes the design of the evaluation; every result records the parameters it used and any departure from it, and the report identifies the design by its hash.
